summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Recommendation: keep private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics, but current public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; it is not certification. Ordinary reversible growth remains CONDITIONAL where it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Analytics is healthy for configured sites; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Revenue claims remain aggregate-only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with site attribution, ROI, margin, and causal lift unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains ACTIVE. Progress: 0 of 4 tasks are evidenced closed; all 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. No task is closed because direct evidence for rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures remains missing. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is BLOCKED pending current written permission or an agreement covering storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, images, prices, and monetization; smallest next action is to assemble the field-level rights matrix and obtain owner-authorized counsel review before any outreach. User alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing evidence is the data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest next action is a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration. GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing evidence is deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review; smallest next action is a read-only consent/configuration capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing evidence is the log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures; smallest next action is a read-only operator/vendor inventory. No item is clear or conditionally approved for public beta until these evidence gaps are resolved.

Private and gated-site decision: retain SearchWoot as private and preview-only. Retain complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net as private, preview-only, and unlaunched; their readiness packets must document ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundaries, rollback, and explicit blockers. Do not publish, configure analytics, monetize, spend, deploy, or expand data collection until the applicable gates and owner disposition are complete.
